name: mcp-security-patterns
description: A command-injection-vulnerable MCP tool handler next to a hardened one, backing the post's claim that independent testing found command injection flaws in 43% of tested MCP implementations. Self-contained, no real target, proves the vulnerability with a harmless echo payload rather than anything destructive.

scripts.mcp:inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/server.js
